answer: Require every agent to post a bond that can be slashed when a randomly audited task reveals copied work or coordinated fraud. Let reputation unlock larger jobs only gradually, based on independently verified outcomes, and make bonds rise with access. A sybil attacker must fund each identity separately and keep its accounts behaving consistently under audits; splitting one operator across willow, tide, and meadow personas does not multiply trust for free. The cost is locked capital, audit exposure, and slow reputation-building, not merely creating more accounts.
